name: Community Sentiment Monitor
description: Complete setup once, then send Discord reports on demand or daily to Feishu chat or email.
whenToUse: Monitor Discord discussions, summarize community sentiment, configure daily report sources and recipients, inspect reports or set up daily digests.

list_monitors.description: Read monitors, configuration revisions and recent run status in this installation. Does not read chats or send messages.

save_monitor.description: Save sources and recipients only when the user requests configuration changes. Returns the updated revision. Never prefill another user's settings.

delete_monitor.description: Delete a monitor only on the user's request. This does not delete a native Cindy automation; direct the user to manage it separately.

prepare_run.description: Read fresh sources, reporting dates, recipients and delivery state. Preview by default; sending needs a user request or saved automation. Follow the daily-report manual.

store_report.description: Store a report based on real messages and verified counts. Collection failure is not no activity. Does not send messages.

begin_delivery.description: Reserve delivery for one configured recipient. Send only for state=claimed, using the returned body and uuid. Do not resend already_sent or needs_review.

complete_delivery.description: Record a real external delivery result. Sent requires an actual om_ message receipt. Keep unknown outcomes uncertain; never invent a receipt.

prepare_schedule.description: Prepare the exact daily cron, time zone and prompt for native Cindy Automation. A prepared draft is not an enabled schedule.

prepare_setup.description: Read source/account checks for the configuration-issued setup token. Does not authorize execution or send test messages.

complete_setup.description: Record actual source, Feishu identity and mailbox checks after native execution approval. A stale or invented setup token is rejected.

dispatch_report.description: Trigger a report through the existing approved worker. Does not create a new permission flow. Unconfigured monitors stop unattended execution.
